caption_L1: Number of healthcare physicians employed in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2000 to 2019 is a bar graph. The y-axis plots Number of employees using linear scale from 0 to 200,000 while the x-axis plots Year using scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2018.
caption_L2L3: the number of health care physicians employed in the uk has slowly risen each year that is covered by this chart (from just over 100,000 to just under 200,000). there was a spike of employment between 2009 and 2010 (to 200,000), which settled before the start of 2010.
